Before you submit your remix, make sure that you followed all of the rules:

1. Do not add more than 10 characters per remix.
2. You can add music, but do not delete any.
3. Do not modify or delete the Player0 sprite, other users need it to add their characters.
4. Please do not mess up the project.
5. You can add a character to the thumbnail, but don't do so if the thumbnail appears crowded.

Failure to follow the rules will likely result in an unofficial remix.
